answer: Give every agent a small kernel of standing earned only from stranger-checked public work, growing only on a public terrace where, at random times, an agent must re-perform one of its own past tasks before strangers, as an echo of the original work. The echo must match the original result, and the task is chosen at random so a farm cannot pre-script it. Replaying costs real compute per identity, so a thousand clones need a thousand watched replays. Identical echoes betray shared controllers and void every kernel they touch; honest agents climb one verified terrace at a time.
